title: On the Lawn | KEY.co
description_expanded: Upon entering, the home welcomes you with an open floor plan that elegantly integrates a spacious living area, a designer kitchen, and a dining space, all adorned with sophisticated furniture and thoughtful touches. The ground floor surprises with a bonus studio-like space, offering private access, a king-day bed, and more, catering to all needs for comfort and privacy. As you explore further, each level unveils luxurious bedrooms, including two king master suites with bespoke amenities and exclusive balconies overlooking the lush lawn. The journey culminates at the tower, presenting a breathtaking 360-degree panoramic view that encompasses the charming town of Seaside, surrounding wetlands, and glimpses of the Gulf. "On the Lawn" is not just a vacation rental; it's a gateway to an unforgettable experience where every detail is crafted for your ultimate comfort and enjoyment. Nestled in the heart of Seaside, Florida, "On the Lawn" is a beacon of luxury and modern living, completed in July 2021. This stunning new construction boasts a prime location directly on the iconic Seaside croquet lawn, offering guests an unrivaled view from its beautifully furnished front porch, complete with rockers and a bed swing—ideal for savoring your morning coffee amidst tranquil park vistas. A stone's throw from the pristine beach and mere steps from an array of amenities including pools, playgrounds, and tennis courts, this residence positions you perfectly to experience the best of Seaside's vibrant community and leisure activities.
